characters.earlierSummary: An older Superman from a future where he retired after Magog's acquittal and then returned to re-form the Justice League. Decades under Earth's sun gave him almost complete immunity to kryptonite; only Captain Marvel's magic lightning seemed to harm him. He fights with Kryptonian strength, heat vision and super-breath.
